title: DAOCare
tagline: DAOCare is the platform to create an ecosystem to help NGOs and other organizations who need funds to help people.
description:
In a disturbing revelation, the women and child development (WCD) ministry has found that nearly 90% of around 1,400 NGOs seeking financial grants under a major training and employment scheme were fake. Because of increasing number of fake proposals the right one has to suffer.

 To minimise fake proposal as much as possible and to maintain continuous distribution of funds we are using Worldcoin to enable one person=one vote and superfluid CFA and IDA to distribute funds with constant flow. To prevent any number of random people to vote who knows nothing about proposal only the active NFT membership holders can vote using Unlock protocol.  The accepted proposals will receive continuous grant using Superfluid. 

We also have functionality to register as an volunteer and as a strategic planner as looking at the NGO sector, one may find that many NGOs do not have well drafted strategic plan and the few NGOs that have the plans are written in a very complex way.These are either too lengthy or too complicated to implement and are therefore not put into use.
So strategic planner will submit the proposal to the executed proposal and if proposer likes it then they will accept the proposal and portion of grants from proposer will flow to strategic planner.
how_its_made:
In a disturbing revelation, the women and child development (WCD) ministry has found that nearly 90% of around 1,400 NGOs seeking financial grants under a major training and employment scheme were fake. Because of increasing number of fake proposals the right one has to suffer.

 To minimise fake proposal as much as possible and to maintain continuous distribution of funds we are using Worldcoin to enable one person=one vote and superfluid CFA and IDA to distribute funds with constant flow. To prevent any number of random people to vote who knows nothing about proposal only the active NFT membership holders can vote using Unlock protocol.  The accepted proposals will receive continuous grant using Superfluid. 

We also have functionality to register as an volunteer and as a strategic planner as looking at the NGO sector, one may find that many NGOs do not have well drafted strategic plan and the few NGOs that have the plans are written in a very complex way.These are either too lengthy or too complicated to implement and are therefore not put into use.
So strategic planner will submit the proposal to the executed proposal and if proposer likes it then they will accept the proposal and portion of grants from proposer will flow to strategic planner.

EPNS Protocol is used to notify about newly created proposal to keep people up-to data and be an active member of DAO.

Covalent API is used to create dashboard for voters which includes voter NFT Token IDs, their account and no of proposal they have voted.

Web3storage is used to store the description of the proposal as storing data onchain is quite expensive.

Subgraph is used to to create GraphQL APIs to query data from our smart contract.

Smart contract is deployed on polygon testnet, optimism and Goreli testnet.

Project is deployed on the Valist platform.
